title_en: The Foolish Young Years Have Passed
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Regretful love song about a couple who never married; origin unclear, I cannot name an author. 'ветивне' and 'зедојме' in the repeat are variant spellings of the same verbs.

lines.cyr: Секоја вечер на тебе мислам еј лудо бре
lines.lat: Sekoja večer na tebe mislam ej ludo bre
lines.en: Every evening I think of you, hey crazy one,

lines.cyr: само се мислам што да ти кажам еј лудо бре.
lines.lat: samo se mislam što da ti kažam ej ludo bre.
lines.en: I only keep thinking what to tell you, hey crazy one.
The foolish young years have passed,

lines.cyr: си ветивме, ама не се зедовме.
lines.lat: si vetivme, ama ne se zedovme.
lines.en: we promised each other, but we did not marry.

lines.cyr: Секоја вечер на порти чекам да поминеш
lines.lat: Sekoja večer na porti čekam da pomineš
lines.en: Every evening I wait at the gate for you to pass by,

lines.cyr: а ти минуваш и не ми збориш не ме гледаш.
lines.lat: a ti minuvaš i ne mi zboriš ne me gledaš.
lines.en: but you pass and do not speak to me, you do not look at me.
The foolish young years have passed,

lines.cyr: си ветивне, ама не се зедојме.
lines.lat: si vetivne, ama ne se zedojme.
lines.en: we promised each other, but we did not marry.

lines.cyr: Ќе мине младост, ќе дојде старост еј лудо бре,
lines.lat: Ḱe mine mladost, ḱe dojde starost ej ludo bre,
lines.en: Youth will pass, old age will come, hey crazy one,

lines.cyr: очите тажни мои и твои ќе останат
lines.lat: očite tažni moi i tvoi ḱe ostanat
lines.en: my sad eyes and yours will remain,

lines.cyr: очите тажни мои до века ќе тагуваат.
lines.lat: očite tažni moi do veka ḱe taguvaat.
lines.en: my sad eyes will grieve forever.
The foolish young years have passed,

lines.cyr: си ветивме, ама не се зедовме.
lines.lat: si vetivme, ama ne se zedovme.
lines.en: we promised each other, but we did not marry.
